title: SeeGULL: A Stereotype Benchmark with Broad Geo-Cultural Coverage Leveraging Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating candidate stereotype tuples (identity, attribute) using few-shot prompted LLMs, validating their prevalence and offensiveness via globally diverse human annotators (in-region vs. out-region), and evaluating embedded stereotype harms in NLI models by calculating mean entailment scores for hypothesis-premise sentence pairs containing regional identities and stereotypical attributes.
